cohort: 3651 women who delivered at a secondary care hospital in rural India, including 83 with eclampsia and 71 with pre-eclampsia.
finding: The study found a high rate of eclampsia compared to pre-eclampsia, suggesting poorer health-seeking behavior and highlighting the need for interventions to improve maternal healthcare access.
mod_finding: More than 50% of women with eclampsia or pre-eclampsia delivered by cesarean section.
